classification: newly reproduced synthetic counterexamples; no external snapshots

cases.selective_solver_admission: Excluding customer changes winner and price from 12 to 8.
cases.sequential_auction_manipulation: A value-4 participant gains 2 by buying first at 1 rather than second at 3.
cases.creator_cross_batch_roundtrip: Buy at 1 in batch A, sell at 3 in B: 2 extracted before fees; no same-batch wash needed.
cases.artificial_creator_demand: 90 recycled creator funds plus 10 independent funds meets a gross threshold of 100; net external demand is 10.
cases.revocable_post_launch_liquidity: An LP can remove all 100 reserves if withdrawal remains authorized; graduation does not preserve depth.
cases.since_is_no_upper_expiry: The same old header and lower-bound since remain admissible later; no authenticated current-height upper bound.
cases.outpoint_revocation_race: Exact gate must be a live dependency; spending it disables later admission, but a fill already ordered first wins. Historical covenant only, not newly executed.
cases.hedge_is_not_inventory: After selling 10 native CKB, cash preserves value but native delivery inventory is zero; hedge execution elsewhere cannot replenish it.
cases.obligations_reduce_equity: 100 assets minus 80 obligations leaves 20; deposited collateral and claims cannot both be free assets.
cases.receipt_deposit_double_count_rejected: Receipt/iCKB ownership is a claim; do not add underlying DAO CKB to the same beneficial balance.
cases.stale_quote_loss: Sell for stale 100, replace inventory for 120, fee 1: realized loss 21.
cases.p2p_netting_not_lp_income: Netting 100 opposite principal at zero spread/fees produces zero LP revenue.
cases.idle_capital_and_delay: Gross 10 less 2 fees and opportunity cost of 100 locked capital for 180/365 years is below gross return.
cases.inventory_exhaustion: One 10-unit fill exhausts a 10-unit delivery inventory even when net equity stays positive.
cases.insufficient_depth_unknown: Insufficient book depth yields UNKNOWN, not fabricated execution.
cases.technical_success_not_profit: A technically valid trade with revenue 1 and cost 2 loses 1.
